features: Refresh the sidebar with compact icon toolbars, filter chips and branch details beside project names.
Use a hideable toolbar in the remote files pane and sort remote listings by name, size or modification time.
Drag remote terminal tabs to reorder them, and use clearer file tree icons and spacing.
fixes: Reduce SSH terminal input latency and focus connected remote terminals without stealing input.
Allow SSH private keys with an empty passphrase.
Keep the input-method anchor stable during terminal redraws while composing.
Avoid false unread indicators from alternate-screen status refreshes, CLI warnings and quota updates.
Suppress native context menus throughout the application.
Update bundled SQLite to 3.54.1 to address RUSTSEC-2026-0459 while retaining SQLx 0.8 compatibility.
Preserve custom remote shortcuts when upgrading older databases with the updated SQLite engine.

features: 侧边栏采用紧凑图标工具栏与筛选标签，分支信息显示在项目名称旁。
远程文件面板支持隐藏工具栏，并可按名称、大小或修改时间排序。
远程终端标签支持拖动排序，文件树图标与间距更加清晰。
fixes: 降低 SSH 终端输入延迟，连接后聚焦远程终端并避免抢占输入。
允许 SSH 私钥使用空密码短语。
输入法组合输入期间，终端重绘时保持候选框位置稳定。
避免备用屏幕状态刷新、CLI 警告和配额更新触发错误的未读提示。
在整个应用中禁用原生右键菜单。
将内置 SQLite 更新至 3.54.1，修复 RUSTSEC-2026-0459，并保持 SQLx 0.8 兼容性。
使用新版 SQLite 升级旧数据库时，保留自定义远程快捷键。
